items.title: GapCNV: A comprehensive framework for CNV detection in low-input DNA sequencing data
items.title_zh: GapCNV：低输入DNA测序数据CNV检测的综合框架
items.summary_zh: 拷贝数变异（CNV）在二倍体和单倍体基因组中均普遍存在， contribute to genome evolution and phenotypic diversity。然而，由于读数浅且高度不均以及扩增偏差，低输入数据（包括低细胞和单细胞测序数据）中的CNV检测仍具挑战性。另一个挑战在于选择参考样本，其用于提供定义拷贝数丢失或获得的基线。使用含常见CNV的参考进行归一化可能导致真实CNV信号抵消或假CNV调用。在此，我们开发了GapCNV，一个用于单倍体和二倍体基因组低输入DNA测序数据CNV检测的统计框架。GapCNV利用初步细胞聚类和共享CNV谱，从推断为拷贝中性状态的细胞构建bin特异性伪参考。该策略减少了常见CNV纳入归一化基线，从而保留常见CNV信号。我们使用含和不含扩增偏差的模拟以及恶性疟原虫、人乳腺癌和黑色素瘤数据集评估了GapCNV。在模拟中，GapCNV实现了高精确率同

extra.description: Copy number variants (CNVs) are prevalent in both diploid and haploid genomes and contribute to genome evolution and phenotypic diversity. However, CNV detection in low-input data, including low-cell and single-cell sequencing data, remains challenging due to the shallow and highly uneven read counts and amplification bias. Another challenge lies in selecting reference samples, which are used to provide a baseline for defining copy-number losses or gains. Normalization using references containing common CNVs can lead to cancellation of true CNV signals or false CNV calls. Here, we develop GapCNV, a statistical framework for CNV detection in low-input DNA sequencing data from both haploid and diploid genomes. GapCNV uses preliminary cell clustering and shared CNV profiles to construct bin-specific pseudo-references from cells inferred to have the copy-neutral state. This strategy reduces the incorporation of common CNVs into the normalization baseline and thereby preserves common CNV signals. We evaluated GapCNV using simulations with and without amplification biases and datasets from Plasmodium falciparum , human breast cancer and melanoma. In simulations, GapCNV achieved high precision rate while maintaining competitive sensitivity, with advantages for detecting short and common CNVs. In P. falciparum , GapCNV detected the known CNVs and recovered the short CNV more frequently than the benchmarking methods. In the melanoma cell line and human breast tumors, GapCNV recovered bulk or single-cell derived copy number profile across individual cells. These results show that adaptive, bin-specific pseudo-reference construction can improve CNV detection when reliable normal controls are unavailable.

items.title: Biosemantic graph transfer learning for cross-patient cell type annotation and cell–cell interaction analysis in tumor single-cell RNA sequencing
items.title_zh: 用于肿瘤单细胞RNA测序中跨患者细胞类型注释和细胞—细胞相互作用分析的生物语义图迁移学习
items.summary_zh: 摘要 通过单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）探索肿瘤微环境（TME）内的细胞异质性，对于理解癌症进展和治疗反应至关重要。然而，当前scRNA-seq方法缺乏空间背景，并依赖不完整的配体—受体相互作用数据集，限制了准确的细胞类型注释和细胞—细胞通讯推断。本研究使用一种新型图神经网络模型应对这些挑战，增强细胞类型预测和细胞相互作用分析。我们的研究使用了来自19名患者、三种癌症类型（白血病、乳腺浸润性癌和结直肠癌）的49 024个细胞组成的数据集。所提出的scGSL模型表现出稳健性能，在所有数据集上平均准确率为84.83%，精确率为86.23%，召回率为81.51%，F1分数为80.92%。这些指标相较现有方法有显著提升，后者通常表现出较低的性能指标。此外，通过回顾现有关于TME内基因相互作用的文献，scGSL模型被证明能以无监督方式稳健识别具有生物学意义的基因相互作用，并通过多种癌症中关键

extra.description: Abstract The exploration of cellular heterogeneity within the tumor microenvironment (TME) via single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) is essential for understanding cancer progression and response to therapy. Current scRNA-seq approaches, however, lack spatial context and rely on incomplete datasets of ligand–receptor interactions, limiting accurate cell type annotation and cell–cell communication inference. This study addresses these challenges using a novel graph neural network model that enhances cell-type prediction and cell-interaction analysis. Our study utilized a dataset consisting of 49 024 cells from 19 patients across three cancer types: leukemia, breast invasive carcinoma, and colorectal cancer. The proposed scGSL model demonstrated robust performance, achieving an average accuracy of 84.83%, precision of 86.23%, recall of 81.51%, and an F1 score of 80.92% across all datasets. These metrics represent a significant enhancement over existing methods, which typically exhibit lower performance metrics. Additionally, by reviewing existing literature on gene interactions within the TME, the scGSL model proves to robustly identify biologically meaningful gene interactions in an unsupervised manner, validated by significant expression differences in key gene pairs across various cancers. The source code and data used in this study can be found at https://github.com/LiYuechao1998/scGSL.

items.title: Systematic clustering alignment and feature characterization for single-cell omics using ACE-OF-Clust
items.title_zh: 使用ACE-OF-Clust进行单细胞组学的系统聚类对齐和特征表征
items.summary_zh: 聚类广泛用于识别细胞分辨率转录组数据中的细胞类型，包括单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）和空间转录组学（ST）。混合成员聚类分配跨聚类的分数成员关系，并捕捉硬聚类之外的连续变异，但整合和解释任一方法的结果因“聚类对齐问题”而变得复杂，该问题源于标签切换、多模态和模型设置差异（包括聚类数量不同）。我们引入ACE-OF-Clust，实现单细胞聚类的四步工作流：多重聚类、聚类对齐、模型比较和识别信息特征。ACE-OF-Clust引入聚类解决方案的直接比较，评估与注释的一致性，并利用特征级聚类谱来优先区分细胞类型的基因，以及评估基因集如何贡献聚类模式。我们使用PBMC scRNA-seq数据、乳腺癌和小鼠胚胎ST数据以及单细胞多组学数据展示了其效用。ACE-OF-Clust量化跨组学聚类变异性，并提出推定的跨组学调控联系。总体而言，ACE-OF-Clust提高了单细胞聚类的可解释性、灵活性和稳

extra.description: Clustering is widely used to identify cell types in cellular-resolution transcriptomic data, including single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) and spatial transcriptomics (ST). Mixed-membership clustering assigns fractional memberships across clusters and captures continuous variation beyond hard clustering, but integrating and interpreting results from either approach is complicated by the “clustering alignment problem,” which arises from label switching, multi-modality, and differences in model settings (including differing numbers of clusters). We introduce ACE-OF-Clust , enabling a four-step workflow for single-cell clustering: multiple clustering, clustering alignment, model comparison, and identification of informative features. ACE-OF-Clust introduces direct comparison of clustering solutions, assesses consistency against annotations, and leverages feature-level clustering profiles to prioritize genes discriminating among cell types, as well as to evaluate how gene sets contribute to clustering patterns. We demonstrate its utility using PBMC scRNA-seq data, breast cancer and mouse embryo ST data, and single-cell multi-omic data. ACE-OF-Clust quantifies cross-omic clustering variability and suggests putative cross-omic regulatory links. Overall, ACE-OF-Clust increases the interpretability, flexibility, and robustness of single-cell clustering, providing a scalable tool for studying cellular heterogeneity and gene expression dynamics.

items.title: GLAlign integrates single-cell multi-omics data via global manifold and local marker gene alignment
items.title_zh: GLAlign通过全局流形和局部标记基因比对整合单细胞多组学数据
items.summary_zh: 摘要 整合异质单细胞多组学数据集仍然具有挑战性，因为不同模态在 distinct 特征空间中测量，且缺乏细胞水平配对。现有流形比对或特征转换框架常受弱跨模态关联、几何模糊和过度校正影响。在此，我们提出GLAlign（全局流形和局部标记基因比对），这是一个优化框架，联合利用全局流形结构和局部标记基因信息来整合单细胞多组学数据。GLAlign通过由最大均值差异、失真和惩罚项组成的全局目标，以及由独立推断簇之间跨模态标记基因重叠引导的局部对比三元组损失，学习共享潜在空间。我们展示了GLAlign的方法学贡献，即通过生物学信息先验扩展流形比对，以确保几何上合理且生物学上正确的比对，而无需配对细胞或人工细胞类型注释。我们在模拟数据和真实数据集上评估了GLAlign，涵盖PBMC scRNA-seq/scATAC-seq、小鼠脑SNARE-seq、单供者和多批次CITE-seq，以及NCI-N87 s

extra.description: Abstract Integrating heterogeneous single-cell multi-omics datasets remains challenging because different modalities are measured in distinct feature spaces and lack cell level pairing. Existing manifold alignment or feature conversion framework are often affected by weak cross-modality associations, geometric ambiguity, and overcorrection. Here we present GLAlign (Global manifold and Local marker gene Alignment), an optimization framework that jointly leverages global manifold structure and local marker gene information to integrate single-cell multi-omics data. GLAlign learns a shared latent space through a global objective comprising maximum mean discrepancy, distortion, and penalty terms, together with a local contrastive triplet loss guided by cross-modality marker gene overlap between independently inferred clusters. We demonstrate GLAlign’s methodological contribution in extending the manifold alignment by biologically informed prior to ensure geometrically plausible and biologically correct alignments without requiring paired cells or manual cell type annotations. We evaluated GLAlign on simulated data and real datasets spanning PBMC scRNA-seq/scATAC-seq, mouse brain SNARE-seq, single-donor and multi-batch CITE-seq, and NCI-N87 scDNA-seq/scRNA-seq integration. Across the evaluated datasets, GLAlign achieved strong modality mixing and biological conservation, remained stable under moderate cell type imbalance and variations in clustering and marker information, and supported cross-modality label transfer and paired cell recovery. These results demonstrate that biologically structured coupling of global and local alignment provides an interpretable framework for heterogeneous single-cell multi-omics integration. GLAlign is freely available at https://github.com/Bateer-Bio/GLAlign.

items.title: mirCCC: Repression-aware graph learning for miRNA-mediated cell-cell communication inference
items.title_zh: mirCCC：用于miRNA介导的细胞间通讯推断的抑制感知图学习
items.summary_zh: 细胞间通讯分析通常关注蛋白质配体和受体，因此错过了细胞外囊泡转移microRNA这一癌症中的重要信号通路。在这里我们表明，可以通过检测已验证miRNA靶基因表达的协调下降，从标准单细胞RNA测序推断microRNA介导的通讯。我们开发了mirCCC，一个计算框架，估计细胞特异性microRNA活性，建模细胞外囊泡转移的细胞发送和接收能力，并从转录组数据学习microRNA解析的通讯图。在具有强混杂信号的合成基准中，mirCCC有所改善，而所有比较方法都下降。应用于人类结直肠癌图谱，mirCCC恢复了已知的结直肠癌相关microRNA，并识别了汇聚于与TGF-β和Wnt/β-catenin信号相关的可塑性程序的基质和髓系到上皮通讯。这些结果为在现有单细胞图谱中研究细胞外囊泡介导的通讯提供了实用途径。

extra.description: Cell-cell communication analyses usually focus on protein ligands and receptors and therefore miss extracellular vesicle transfer of microRNAs, an important route of signalling in cancer. Here we show that microRNA-mediated communication can be inferred from standard single-cell RNA sequencing by detecting coordinated decreases in the expression of validated miRNA target genes. We developed mirCCC, a computational framework that estimates cell-specific microRNA activity, models cellular sending and receiving capacity for extracellular vesicle transfer, and learns microRNA-resolved communication graphs from transcriptomic data. In synthetic benchmarks with strong confounding signals, mirCCC improved whereas all comparison methods declined. Applied to a human colorectal cancer atlas, mirCCC recovered known colorectal cancer-associated microRNAs and identified stromal- and myeloid-to-epithelial communication converging on a plasticity program linked to TGF- β and Wnt/ β -catenin signalling. These results provide a practical route for studying extracellular vesicle-mediated communication in existing single-cell atlases.

items.title: Generating scRNA-seq data from bulk RNA-seq using a Gaussian mixture variational autoencoder
items.title_zh: 使用高斯混合变分自编码器从bulk RNA-seq生成scRNA-seq数据
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）在单细胞分辨率提供详细的、全基因组范围的基因表达谱，能够识别驱动疾病的细胞类型和基因。然而，scRNA-seq仍然昂贵，即使在最广泛的人类疾病研究中生成的样本也极其有限。相比之下，bulk RNA-seq数据丰富，但对所有细胞类型的基因表达取平均，丢失了细胞特异性细节。为了进一步利用丰富的RNA-seq数据，已开发出使用scRNA-seq作为参考从bulk数据推断细胞类型比例和平均表达的方法。此外，生成式AI模型已被开发用于生成更多现有scRNA-seq数据集、从bulk生成空间转录组数据，以及从bulk生成完整的单细胞数据集（带有不完整的单细胞数据），用于大型队列研究。然而，缺乏专门致力于从bulk RNA-seq数据生成代表性单细胞RNA-seq的工具。为解决这个问题，我们开发了一个创新的模块化框架，称为Bulk2SC，充分利用强大的生成式AI方法

extra.description: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) provides detailed, genome-wide gene expression profiles at single-cell resolution, enabling the identification of disease-driving cell types and genes. However, scRNA-seq remains costly, and there are extremely limited samples generated in even the most extensive human disease studies. In contrast, bulk RNA-seq data is abundant but averages gene expression across all cell types, losing cell-specific detail. To further leverage this abundance of RNA-seq data, methods have been developed to infer cell type proportions and average expression from bulk data using scRNA-seq as a reference. Additionally, generative AI models have been developed to generate more of an existing scRNA-seq dataset, spatial transcriptome data from bulk, and a complete single-cell dataset from bulk, with an incomplete set of single-cell data, for large cohort studies. However, there is a lack of tools specifically dedicated to generating representative single-cell RNA-seq from bulk RNA-seq data. To address this, we develop an innovative, modular framework, termed Bulk2SC, that takes full advantage of powerful generative AI approaches and existing scRNA-seq data to generate representative scRNA-seq data from bulk RNA-seq. Bulk2SC uses a Gaussian mixture variational autoencoder for data generation together with any tool that predicts cell type proportions from bulk RNA-seq data. We demonstrate the superior performance of Bulk2SC relative to tools that generate scRNA-seq from bulk RNA-seq as part of broader computational frameworks on published datasets from multiple tissue types. We also apply and assess Bulk2SC on a benchmark deconvolution dataset that contains paired bulk and single nucleus RNA-seq data. The modular design of Bulk2SC allows for deconvolution of single datasets as well as straightforward implementation within larger computational frameworks.

items.title: ZipAEr: A compressive convolutional autoencoder for high-dimensional spatial omics data at subcellular resolution
items.title_zh: ZipAEr：一种用于亚细胞分辨率高维空间组学数据的压缩卷积自编码器
items.summary_zh: 摘要 背景 空间转录组学的最新进展，如CosMx空间分子成像仪，使得能够在亚细胞分辨率下检测和定量数千种RNA转录本。虽然这些数据提供了前所未有的洞察，但计算分析仍然是一个重大瓶颈。当前方法通常依赖精确的细胞分割在细胞水平上聚合转录本——这在脑等复杂组织中是一项众所周知的困难任务。深度学习自编码器提供了一种无需分割的像素级替代方案，但面临重大工程障碍：标准卷积架构在扩展通道深度的同时降低空间分辨率。当应用于高plex数据时，这种“通道扩展”产生 prohibitive 的内存需求，超出当前可用硬件的限制。结果 为克服这一计算障碍，我们推出ZipAEr，一个深度学习框架，具有新颖的“双重压缩”架构，同时沿空间和通道轴降低维度。我们在CosMx人额叶皮层数据集上验证了ZipAEr——这是一个公开可用资源，提供人脑组织中单分子亚细胞分辨率（20–50 nm）和超高plex覆盖（超过6,000个基

extra.description: Abstract Background Recent advances in spatial transcriptomics, such as the CosMx Spatial Molecular Imager, enable the detection and quantification of thousands of RNA transcripts at subcellular resolution. While these data offer unprecedented insight, computational analysis remains a significant bottleneck. Current methods typically aggregate transcripts at the cell level, relying on precise cell segmentation—a notoriously difficult task in complex tissues like the brain. Deep learning autoencoders offer a segmentation-free, pixel-level alternative but face a major engineering hurdle: standard convolutional architectures expand channel depth while reducing spatial resolution. When applied to high-plex data, this “channel expansion” creates prohibitive memory requirements that exceed the limits of currently available hardware. Results To overcome this computational barrier, we introduce ZipAEr, a deep learning framework featuring a novel “dual-compression” architecture that simultaneously reduces dimensionality along both the spatial and channel axes. We validated ZipAEr on the CosMx human frontal cortex dataset—a publicly available resource that provides single-molecule subcellular resolution (20–50 nm) and ultra-high-plex coverage (more than 6,000 genes) in human brain tissue. ZipAEr effectively compressed these high-dimensional data, reducing memory requirements by factors of 195 × to 1,649 × (depending on model depth) while preserving essential biological information. In a downstream classification task identifying MAPT -positive neurons, a classifier trained on ZipAEr’s latent representations outperformed a baseline model with the same architecture but trained on raw data, with similar accuracy (69% vs. 68%) but substantially higher precision (75% vs. 68%) and specificity (69% vs. 48%). Conclusions ZipAEr establishes a scalable, segmentation-free framework for pixel-level analysis of high-plex spatial omics data. By resolving the channel-expansion problem, ZipAEr enables researchers to investigate subcellular mechanisms in complex tissues.

items.title: ASAOT: an accentuated structure-differentiated asymmetric optimal transport model for cell type and single-cell spatial mapping
items.title_zh: ASAOT：一种用于细胞类型和单细胞空间映射的增强结构差异化非对称最优传输模型
items.summary_zh: 摘要 空间转录组学（STs）表征时空基因表达，并促进对组织微环境中细胞结构和细胞间通讯的分析。然而，现有空间解卷积方法采用全局固定平滑而无局部锐化，这会模糊细胞边界并阻碍脑组织中分层、异质性细胞模式的重建。在此，我们提出增强结构差异化非对称最优传输（ASAOT），一个基于结构增强非对称最优传输的解卷积框架。结合空间邻域约束，ASAOT引入差异化增强锐化项以维持全局空间连续性、增强边界检测并保留斑点级表达异质性。利用非对称最优传输，该框架联合估计斑点级细胞类型比例并对参考单细胞坐标进行空间分配。在多种模拟数据集上的基准测试表明，ASAOT在中等空间分辨率下实现了有竞争力的整体准确性和稳健性，在测试方法中平均综合排名最佳。应用于小鼠嗅球和大脑皮层数据集表明，ASAOT减少了信号扩散和边界失真，有效恢复分层脑解剖结构和分层细胞分布，从而构建参考单细胞图谱的可解释空间图。总体而言，ASAOT通过锐

extra.description: Abstract Spatial transcriptomics (STs) characterizes spatiotemporal gene expression and facilitates analysis of cellular architecture and cell–cell crosstalk within tissue microenvironments. However, existing spatial deconvolution methods employ globally fixed smoothing without local sharpening, which blurs cellular boundaries and impedes reconstruction of layered, heterogeneous cellular patterns in brain tissue. Here, we present Accentuated Structure-differentiated Asymmetric Optimal Transport (ASAOT), a deconvolution framework built on structure-enhanced asymmetric optimal transport. Coupled with spatial neighborhood constraints, ASAOT introduces a differentiated accentuated sharpening term to maintain global spatial continuity, enhance boundary detection, and preserve spot-level expression heterogeneity. Using asymmetric optimal transport, the framework jointly estimates spot-wise cell-type proportions and performs spatial assignment of reference single-cell coordinates. Benchmarks on diverse simulated datasets demonstrate that ASAOT achieves competitive overall accuracy and robustness across moderate spatial resolutions, with the best average comprehensive rank among tested methods. Applications to mouse olfactory bulb and cerebral cortex datasets demonstrate that ASAOT reduces signal diffusion and boundary distortion, effectively recovering layered brain anatomy and stratified cell distributions to build interpretable spatial maps of reference single-cell profiles. Collectively, ASAOT addresses critical drawbacks of conventional methods via a sharpening regularization term, serving as a reliable tool for STs analysis and mechanism exploration of tissue spatial organization.

items.title: spOT-NMF: gene expression deconvolution via optimal transport with proximity-aware niche mapping for spatial transcriptomics
items.title_zh: spOT-NMF：通过最优传输与邻近感知生态位映射进行基因表达反卷积用于空间转录组学
items.summary_zh: 摘要 空间转录组学能够直接分析完整组织内的细胞组织，然而两个挑战限制了其充分利用：混合表达信号（包括异种移植等物种混合模型）的准确无参考反卷积，以及缺乏能将每个斑点的程序使用值转化为空间生态位的工具。我们开发了spOT-NMF，一种基于最优传输的非负矩阵分解方法，用Wasserstein距离替代标准重建损失，无需匹配的单细胞图谱即可解开混合信号。虽然广义OT-NMF分解适用于任何表达矩阵，但基于邻近性的生态位推断模块进一步将空间转录组中的程序共使用转化为定义组织区室及其边界的方向共现网络。在涵盖亚细胞到多细胞分辨率、多个平台和两种物种混合场景的五个金标准数据集上进行基准测试，spOT-NMF在无参考方法中排名第一，在异种移植特有的信号不平衡条件下尤其具有优势。我们表明无参考反卷积能够恢复匹配单细胞图谱中缺失的细胞群体，突显了无监督分析的价值。应用于胶质母细胞瘤异种移植和人类结直肠癌，spO

extra.description: Abstract Spatial transcriptomics enables direct profiling of cellular organization within intact tissues, yet two challenges limit its full exploitation: accurate reference-free deconvolution of mixed expression signals (including species-admixed models such as xenografts), and lack of tools that can translate per-spot program usage values into spatial niches. We developed spOT-NMF, an optimal transport-based non-negative matrix factorization method that replaces standard reconstruction loss with the Wasserstein distance to disentangle mixed signals without requiring matched single-cell atlases. While the generalized OT-NMF factorization is applicable to any expression matrix, a proximity-based niche inference module further translates program co-usage from spatial transcriptomes into directional co-occurrence networks that define tissue compartments and their boundaries. Benchmarking across five gold-standard datasets spanning sub-cellular to multi-cellular resolutions, multiple platforms, and two-species admixture scenarios, spOT-NMF ranks first among reference-free methods, with particular advantage under the signal imbalance conditions characteristic of xenografts. We show that reference-free deconvolution recovers cell populations absent from matched single-cell atlases, highlighting the value of unsupervised analysis. Applied to glioblastoma xenografts and human colorectal cancer, spOT-NMF reveals spatially restricted interferon signaling, invasion routes, and CAF–tumor boundaries. spOT-NMF is available as an open-source Python package with GPU, CPU, and HPC support.

items.title: MitoLODE: a virtual mitochondrion framework with knowledge graph priors for trajectory modeling and mechanistic perturbation analysis
items.title_zh: MitoLODE：一个具有知识图谱先验的虚拟线粒体框架，用于轨迹建模和机制扰动分析
items.summary_zh: 摘要 线粒体在重大疾病发病机制中发挥核心作用。追踪它们在疾病条件下如何演变对于理解病理机制和识别干预窗口很有价值。现有的单细胞轨迹推断方法依赖伪时间而非真实时间轴，且很少将疾病和对照建模为独立轨迹。虚拟细胞方法针对一次性药物扰动响应，不处理疾病表型的连续时间演变。为解决这些差距，我们提出虚拟线粒体研究范式。我们首先整理并构建了MitoKG，一个从五个权威数据库整合的线粒体特异性异质知识图谱。MitoKG包含4种类型的2549个节点和5种关系类型的23019条边。基于这些先验，我们开发了MitoLODE，一个条件双轨迹神经常微分方程框架。MitoLODE在编码、连续时间动力学和解码过程中嵌入图先验和时间特征，将疾病和对照演变建模为两条耦合路径。在涵盖帕金森病、心脏和胰腺分化的四个数据集上与八个基线进行基准测试，MitoLODE在大多数设置中领先，并在低数据状态和向未见时间点外推时保持稳健。两

extra.description: Abstract Mitochondria play a central role in the pathogenesis of major diseases. Tracking how they evolve under disease conditions is valuable for understanding pathological mechanisms and identifying intervention windows. Existing single-cell trajectory inference methods rely on pseudotime rather than a real temporal axis, and rarely model disease and control as independent trajectories. Virtual cell methods target one-shot drug perturbation responses and do not handle the continuous temporal evolution of disease phenotypes. To address these gaps, we propose a virtual mitochondrion research paradigm. We first curate and construct MitoKG, a mitochondria-specific heterogeneous knowledge graph integrated from five authoritative databases. MitoKG contains 2549 nodes of four types and 23 019 edges of five relation types. Building on these priors, we develop MitoLODE, a conditioned dual-trajectory neural ordinary differential equation framework. MitoLODE embeds graph priors and temporal features throughout encoding, continuous-time dynamics, and decoding, modeling disease and control evolution as two coupled paths. Benchmarked against eight baselines across four datasets covering Parkinson’s disease, cardiac, and pancreatic differentiation, MitoLODE leads in most settings and remains robust under low-data regimes and extrapolation to unseen time points. Two synthetic datasets with known ground truth validate its trajectory recovery under controlled conditions. Building on the trained model, we design a gradient-guided perturbation procedure that identifies potential intervention targets aligned with known Parkinson’s pathology. We develop MGMI, a large language model-based reasoning module that grounds model outputs in MitoKG nodes and turns them into confidence-graded mechanistic hypotheses, which nonetheless require experimental validation.

items.title: Identifying multi-omics spatial domains via masked autoencoder and diffusion-based latent regularization with SpaMEDM
items.title_zh: 通过掩码自编码器和基于扩散的潜在正则化与SpaMEDM识别多组学空间域
items.summary_zh: 摘要 空间多组学数据提供了组织组织的互补分子视图。然而，由于数据稀疏性、技术噪声和模态特异性分布，其整合仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们提出了空间掩码自编码器和基于扩散的模型（SpaMEDM），一个端到端图表示学习框架，它增强了双注意力图整合骨干，并加入了掩码重建和基于扩散的潜在噪声预测正则化。在掩码轨道中，通过利用模态和图特定的邻域信息来恢复随机掩码的斑点特征。同时，在随机采样的噪声水平下对模态特定的潜在表示施加高斯扰动，并训练一个空间图信息网络来预测注入的噪声。这种基于扩散的目标仅在训练期间使用，以鼓励对潜在扰动的鲁棒性，而不是在推理期间执行迭代反向扩散或采样。此外，基于余弦的配对斑点方向对齐和邻接重建鼓励兼容的跨模态表示并保留所选图结构。SpaMEDM灵活支持纯空间、双特征-空间和模态特定特征修剪的空间图配置。在不同空间多组学数据集上的评估展示了有竞争力的空间域识别性能，并产生促进下游探

extra.description: Abstract Spatial multi-omics data provide complementary molecular views of tissue organization. However, their integration remains challenging due to data sparsity, technical noise, and modality-specific distributions. Here, we present Spatial Masked autoEncoder and Diffusion-based Model (SpaMEDM), an end-to-end graph representation learning framework that augments a dual-attention graph-integration backbone with masked reconstruction and diffusion-based latent noise-prediction regularization. In the masked track, randomly masked spot features are recovered by leveraging modality- and graph-specific neighborhood information. In parallel, Gaussian perturbations are applied to modality-specific latent representations at randomly sampled noise levels, and a spatial-graph-informed network is trained to predict the injected noise. This diffusion-based objective is used exclusively during training to encourage robustness to latent perturbations, rather than to perform iterative reverse diffusion or sampling during inference. Furthermore, cosine-based paired-spot directional alignment and adjacency reconstruction encourage compatible cross-modality representations and preservation of the selected graph structure. SpaMEDM flexibly supports purely spatial, dual feature–spatial, and modality-specific feature-pruned spatial graph configurations. Evaluations across diverse spatial multi-omics datasets demonstrate competitive spatial-domain identification performance and produce integrated embeddings that facilitate downstream exploratory analyses.

items.title: Evaluating agentic bioinformatics through functionality, evidence, and validation
items.title_zh: 通过功能性、证据和验证评估代理式生物信息学
items.summary_zh: 摘要 大语言模型智能体越来越多地规划、执行和解读生物分析，但流畅的回复、成功的工具调用和基准性能本身并不能确立科学可信度。现有综述从互补视角审视生物智能体，包括应用、架构、智能体能力、证据支撑和评估，但很少针对同一系统–用例轨迹将这些属性联合操作化。我们通过将可检查的工作流轨迹——而非仅架构或最终输出——作为主要分析单元来填补这一空白。我们引入功能–证据–验证（FEV）框架，该框架区分已展示的工作流操作、对行动和主张的可追溯支持，以及用例特定工作流评估所报告的严谨性。验证将成功执行与可重放计算、科学评估和前瞻性实证测试区分开来。使用FEV，我们映射了七个生物信息学领域中319条智能体或智能体邻近的系统–用例记录和35个基准或评估资源。八篇出版物对两个类别均有贡献，产生346篇唯一出版物。在预设标准下，167条记录被归类为完全智能体，152条为智能体邻近。跨领域来看，规划和工具介导的执行被记

extra.description: Abstract Large language model agents increasingly plan, execute, and interpret biological analyses, yet fluent responses, successful tool calls, and benchmark performance alone do not establish scientific credibility. Existing reviews examine biological agents from complementary perspectives, including application, architecture, agentic capability, evidence grounding, and evaluation, but rarely operationalize these properties jointly for the same system–use-case trajectory. We address this gap by treating the inspectable workflow trajectory, rather than architecture or final output alone, as the primary unit of analysis. We introduce the Functionality–Evidence–Validation (FEV) framework, which separates demonstrated workflow operations, traceable support for actions and claims, and the reported rigor of use-case-specific workflow evaluation. Validation distinguishes successful execution from replayable computation, scientific assessment, and prospective empirical testing. Using FEV, we map 319 agentic or agent-adjacent system–use-case records and 35 benchmark or evaluation resources across seven bioinformatics domains. Eight publications contributed to both categories, yielding 346 unique publications. Under prespecified criteria, 167 records were classified as full-agentic and 152 as agent-adjacent. Across domains, planning and tool-mediated execution were documented more frequently than replayability, prospective empirical testing, and closed-loop empirical refinement. Benchmark performance, database grounding, model predictions, and retrospective biological observations provided distinct forms of evidence but did not independently establish replayability or validate the agent-controlled workflow. These findings characterize reporting within the curated evidence map rather than field-wide prevalence. FEV provides a practical basis for comparing systems and designing transparent, auditable, and scientifically accountable bioinformatics workflows.

items.title: Structured multi-view relational learning for drug response prediction
items.title_zh: 用于药物反应预测的结构化多视图关系学习
items.summary_zh: 摘要 药物反应预测（DRP）需要能够联合表征分子药物结构和异质细胞状态的模型。尽管近期深度学习方法已将多组学图谱与药物表征整合，但许多方法将组学视图视为并行特征来源或在关系建模前将其合并，这可能削弱组学视图特异的细胞系关系结构。在此，我们提出MulDR，一个结构化多视图关系学习框架，在药物条件化的细胞–药物交互之前保留组学视图特异的细胞系关系结构。MulDR为通路活性、基因表达、突变和DNA甲基化构建独立的关系结构，学习视图特异的关系细胞表征，并使用互补的基序级、几何感知分子图和Morgan指纹药物表征来条件化其融合。通过这种设计，细胞系相似性在交互阶段之前保持视图依赖，而非被过早压缩为单一特征或关系空间。大量实验表明，MulDR在相同评估协议下持续优于代表性和近期基线，相对于最强基线将均方根误差降低6.07%。对未见药物和细胞系的冷启动评估进一步表明MulDR能泛化到先前未见的实体，而消

extra.description: Abstract Drug response prediction (DRP) requires models that jointly characterize molecular drug structure and heterogeneous cellular states. Although recent deep learning approaches have integrated multi-omics profiles with drug representations, many treat omics views as parallel feature sources or merge them before relational modeling, which can weaken omics-view-specific cell-line relation structures. Here, we propose MulDR, a structured multi-view relational learning framework that preserves omics-view-specific cell-line relation structures before drug-conditioned cell–drug interaction. MulDR constructs separate relation structures for pathway activity, gene expression, mutation, and DNA methylation, learns view-specific relational cell representations, and uses complementary motif-level, geometry-aware molecular graph, and Morgan fingerprint drug representations to condition their fusion. With this design, cell-line similarity remains view-dependent until the interaction stage, rather than being prematurely compressed into a single feature or relation space. Extensive experiments show that MulDR consistently outperforms representative and recent baselines under the same evaluation protocol, reducing root mean square error by 6.07% relative to the strongest baseline. Cold-start evaluations on unseen drugs and cell lines further show that MulDR generalizes to previously unseen entities, while ablation studies show that removing either view-specific relational modeling or drug-conditioned fusion consistently compromises predictive performance. Together, these results suggest that preserving omics-specific cell-line relations before drug-conditioned interaction modeling provides an effective strategy for robust DRP.

items.title: me2SNP: a software tool for extracting SNP genotypes from DNA methylation array to facilitate multi-omics disease research

extra.description: Abstract Background Illumina DNA methylation microarrays, such as the HumanMethylation450K (450 K) and MethylationEPIC (850 K) BeadChips, are widely used in complex disease studies. However, a considerable amount of latent SNP genotyping information embedded within these arrays remains underutilized, representing a significant untapped resource for integrated multi-omics analyses. Results Here, we developed me2SNP, a user-friendly Java Graphical User Interface (GUI) tool to extract SNP genotypes from DNA methylation array data, freely available at http://www.onethird-lab.com/me2SNP . Applying me2SNP to the 450 K and 850 K arrays, a total of 18,238 and 19,415 color-channel-switching SNPs (CCSSNPs), along with 54 and 50 explicit SNPs, can be recovered, respectively. Independent validation across 30 MethylationEPIC array-runs from seven GIAB reference samples showed genotype concordance ranging from 90.2% to 92.0% with GIAB high-confidence WGS calls at the evaluated non-reference overlapping loci. me2SNP enables the simultaneous generation of SNP genotypes and DNA methylation profiles from the same set of samples, providing a unique opportunity for multi-omics studies such as methylation quantitative trait loci (meQTL) analysis. Conclusions We anticipate that me2SNP will be widely adopted to advance genetics, epigenetics, and interaction studies, particularly in revealing regulatory mechanisms underlying complex diseases.

items.title: Web-based analysis of microscopy images with Galaxy Image Analysis
items.title_zh: 基于Web的显微图像分析，使用Galaxy Image Analysis

extra.description: Abstract Background We present Galaxy Image Analysis, a software suite for web-based analysis of high-content and high-throughput cell microscopy image data. Galaxy Image Analysis builds upon the Galaxy platform, an open-source scientific workflow management system, which enables upscaling workflows, collaborative data analysis, and reproducible science. While Galaxy was originally developed for analyzing genomic sequencing data, we have extended the Galaxy ecosystem by developing tools and workflows for different image analysis tasks. Results Galaxy Image Analysis has a web-based graphical user interface, is user-friendly, and well-suited for non-experts and cloud environments. The developed web-based software provides a wide spectrum of tools for microscopy image analysis, which can be combined to build more powerful automated workflows. The tools and workflows comprise image enhancement, cell segmentation, cell counting, feature extraction, image registration, and visualization. Tools for validation and performance evaluation are also included. The software was successfully applied for analyzing cell microscopy images in different biological applications. Use cases of image analysis tools and workflows are presented. We also performed a quantitative evaluation including a comparison with other tools. Conclusions The web-based software suite Galaxy Image Analysis has a high level of user adoption. The software is open-source and publicly available. Galaxy Image Analysis is an important bioinformatics resource for researchers in the life sciences.

items.title: A hybrid mixture approach for clustering and characterizing biomedical data
items.title_zh: 一种用于生物医学数据聚类和表征的混合混合方法
items.summary_zh: 基于模型的聚类（MBC）广泛用于识别生物医学数据中的潜在分组和表征异质结构。然而，现代生物医学研究常生成大样本量和多变量的数据集，标准MBC方法难以可靠高效拟合。因子分析混合（MFA）通过少数潜在因子表示高维协方差结构，从而降低协方差维度，部分解决了这一挑战。然而，当前MFA估计方法由于嵌套EM型算法收敛缓慢，对大规模数据往往计算上不切实际。此外，许多现有实现要求各聚类具有相同数量的潜在因子，限制了捕捉组特定结构的能力。我们提出一种混合无矩阵计算方案，用于准确高效估计高斯因子分析混合，避免显式构建或存储大协方差矩阵。我们进一步开发了允许不同聚类具有不同因子数量的广义版本，为组特定表征提供额外灵活性。模拟研究表明，所提方法比现有方法收敛显著更快，尤其在高维设置中，同时保持高聚类和估计精度。应用于Wisconsin乳腺癌数据集、淋巴瘤基因表达数据集和人脑单细胞RNA测序数据集，展示了对良恶性乳

extra.description: Model-based clustering (MBC) is widely used for identifying latent groups and characterizing heterogeneous structures in biomedical data. However, modern biomedical studies often generate datasets with large sample sizes and many variables, for which standard MBC approaches can be difficult to fit reliably and efficiently. Mixture of factor analyzers (MFA) addresses part of this challenge by representing high-dimensional covariance structures through a few underlying factors, thereby reducing the covariance dimensionality. However, current estimation methods for MFA are often computationally impractical for massive data due to the slow convergence of nested EM-type algorithms. Moreover, many existing implementations require a common number of latent factors across clusters, limiting their ability to capture group-specific structures. We propose a hybrid matrix-free computational scheme for accurate and efficient estimation of Gaussian mixture of factor analyzers, which avoids explicit construction or storage of large covariance matrices. We further develop a generalized version that allows different clusters to have varying numbers of factors, providing additional flexibility for group-specific characterization. Simulation studies show that the proposed approach achieves substantially faster convergence than the existing method, especially in high-dimensional settings, while preserving high clustering and estimation accuracy. Applications to the Wisconsin breast cancer dataset, a lymphoma gene-expression dataset, and a human brain single-cell RNA sequencing dataset demonstrate accurate identification of benign/malignant breast tumors, lymphoma subtypes, and neuronal and astrocytic cell populations. The fitted factor-loading structures reveal biologically meaningful differences in nuclear morphology for breast tumors, with malignant samples showing stronger irregularity-related variation, group-specific gene-expression heterogeneity among the three lymphoma subtypes, and distinct patterns of transcriptional variation between neurons and astrocytes, with neuronal variation reflecting a broader set of coordinated transcriptional directions and astrocytic variation concentrated in a more compact latent structure.

items.title: User-friendly transcriptomic data analysis with ArrayAnalysis
items.title_zh: 使用ArrayAnalysis进行用户友好的转录组数据分析
items.summary_zh: 摘要 背景 转录组分析已成为现代生物医学研究的基石。为使转录组分析更广泛地惠及科学界，特别是包括生物信息学专业知识有限的研究人员，我们于2013年推出ArrayAnalysis，作为一个用户友好的基于网络的微阵列数据分析应用。我们现在展示重大更新（https://arrayanalysis.org），引入一个高度交互的平台，便于对微阵列和RNA-seq数据进行专门探索和分析，并允许生成可发表的输出。结果 用户可通过顺序交互工作流执行关键分析步骤，包括数据预处理和质量控制、差异表达分析和基因集分析。每一步，应用提供交互式可视化及信息页面以支持解读。用户可动态调整图形布局和调色板，并将图形导出为矢量图形和高分辨率栅格图像。对于非专家用户，ArrayAnalysis提供逐步指导以支持正确使用和促进学习，而对于经验丰富的生物信息学家，它提供 streamlined 灵活的工作流，非常适合需要高效一

extra.description: Abstract Background Transcriptomic profiling has become a cornerstone of modern biomedical research. To make transcriptomic analyses accessible to a broader scientific community, specifically including researchers with limited bioinformatics expertise, we introduced ArrayAnalysis in 2013 as a user-friendly web-based application for microarray data analysis. We now present a major update ( https://arrayanalysis.org ), introducing a strongly interactive platform that facilitates the dedicated exploration and analysis of both microarray and RNA-seq data, and allows for the generation of publication-ready outputs. Results Users can perform key analysis steps, including data pre-processing and quality control, differential expression analysis, and gene set analysis, via a sequential, interactive workflow. At each step, the application provides interactive visualizations accompanied by information pages to support interpretation. Users can dynamically adjust figure layouts and colour palettes and export figures as vector graphics and high-resolution raster images. For non-expert users, ArrayAnalysis offers step-by-step guidance to support correct usage and facilitate learning, while for experienced bioinformaticians, it provides a streamlined and flexible workflow ideal for large-scale analyses requiring efficient and consistent processing. ArrayAnalysis is available both as a web application and for local deployment as a desktop application, Docker image, or R package, making it suitable for diverse computational environments, user groups, and analytical purposes. Conclusions The updated ArrayAnalysis platform provides an accessible yet flexible solution for the analysis and exploration of microarray and RNA-seq data, empowering a broad community of biomedical researchers to unlock the full potential of transcriptomic data.

items.title: Determining gene specificity from multivariate single-cell RNA sequencing data
items.title_zh: 从多变量单细胞 RNA 测序数据确定基因特异性
items.summary_zh: 摘要 背景 单细胞基因组学实验的一个重要应用是识别特定于生物学类别或实验条件的基因。我们开发了 ember（Entropy Metrics for Biological ExploRation），一个基于熵的框架，使用 Shannon 链式规则跨嵌套生物分区。四个公理表征了其在一类归一化熵分解分数中的 Ψ 分数。结果 将 ember 应用于来自八个 founder 小鼠品系的八个组织，我们发现基因特异性往往不直观：经典标记可以被替代，管家基因是上下文依赖的，小鼠品系可以驱动意外的细胞类型转换。对熵度量的无监督学习揭示了共享的专门化于雄性性腺和肾脏的基因，以及特定于肾脏非连续发育阶段的基因。为促进小鼠基因特异性的进一步探索，我们还开发了一个全面的特异性数据库，以及网络界面、API 和 MCP 服务器。将 ember 扩展到从255个多样化个体收集的人类 PBMC 数据集，我们发现 PBMC

extra.description: Abstract Background An important application of single-cell genomics experiments is to identify genes specific to biological categories or experimental conditions. We develop ember (Entropy Metrics for Biological ExploRation), an entropy-based framework that uses Shannon’s chain rule across nested biological partitions. Four axioms characterize its Ψ score within a class of normalized entropy-decomposition scores. Results Applying ember to eight tissues from eight founder mouse strains, we find that gene specificity is often unintuitive: canonical markers can be supplanted, housekeeping genes are context-dependent, and mouse strain can drive unexpected cell type switching. Unsupervised learning on entropy metrics uncovers shared genes specialized to male gonads and kidney, as well as genes specific to non-consecutive developmental stages in the kidney. To facilitate further exploration of gene specificity in mice, we have also developed a comprehensive specificity database, along with a web interface, API and MCP server. Extending ember to a human PBMC dataset collected from 255 diverse individuals, we find that variation in PBMCs is largely localized to classical monocytes. We also find genes with unique specificity by sex, age and ancestral background. Conclusions Together, these applications establish ember as a powerful tool and provide a roadmap for elucidating the impact of human genetic variation using the murine model.

items.title: 基于多智能体深度强化学习的SD-IoT控制器部署
items.title_zh: 基于多智能体深度强化学习的SD-IoT控制器部署
items.summary_zh: 物联网(IoT)中激增的流量, 影响了传感器等设备的数据传输。利用软件定义网络(SDN)技术可以优化网络性能, 提高数据传输质量。然而, 物联网中流量等网络状态的不断变化会影响软件定义网络控制平面的性能。研究软件定义物联网(SD-IoT)中的动态控制器部署问题, 以在流量变化时保证控制平面性能。考虑到物联网节点的能耗以及数据传输的特点, 在部署控制器时, 综合考虑延迟、控制可靠性以及能耗的影响, 并将该问题构建为马尔可夫博弈过程。为了同时兼顾单一控制器性能以及控制平面整体性能, 采用多智能体深度强化学习求解该问题。在部署阶段利用动作掩码屏蔽部分节点, 避免将控制器部署在性能不足或者供能不方便的节点。仿真实验表明, 与基于Louvain社区划分和基于单智能体深度Q网络(DQN)的部署算法相比, 所提算法可以更好地找到高性能的部署方案。

items.title: 云网融合环境下组合服务的动态重构
items.title_zh: 云网融合环境下组合服务的动态重构
items.summary_zh: 随着云计算与空天地海一体化通信网络的深度融合, 各种复杂应用场景的出现使得组合服务的种类和数量急剧增多, 结构也变得复杂。在云网融合环境下, 用户移动设备和边缘服务器等硬件能力有限, 能耗问题成为组合服务进行动态重构不可忽略的重要因素。此外, 传统方法并未考虑空天地海不同场景下用户对不同服务质量(QoS)属性需求的差异性, 使得组合服务的交付结果并不令人满意。为了解决上述问题, 提出一种基于多目标粒子群优化(PSO)的组合服务动态重构方法。该方法首先根据重构原子服务的三维空间地理位置和功能进行聚类, 有效解决在云网融合环境下服务规模庞大情况下的搜索空间爆炸问题; 然后通过能耗计算模型得到服务调用的综合能耗, 并将其作为动态重构的优化目标之一, 结合服务的多种QoS属性进行多目标寻优, 最终生成符合用户需求且能耗较低的重构方案。实验结果表明, 该方法在云网融合环境下节约能耗和应对较大候选服务

items.title: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
items.title_zh: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
items.summary_zh: 在高速收费站拥堵检测场景中, 遮挡、阴影、景深等因素严重影响检测算法的精度, 基于单信息的拥堵检测算法无法准确反映收费站真实拥堵情况, 对此, 提出一种高速收费站多信息融合拥堵检测算法。首先采用目标检测算法检测目标区域车辆, 利用图像空间特征计算车道占用率; 其次利用Deep SORT目标跟踪算法与滑动平衡机制进行车流量综合估计, 减少因为遮挡和阴影导致的车辆误检、漏检问题; 最后利用基于光流信息熵的车速估计方法, 降低因景深变化导致的拥堵状态检测误差。通过融合3种不同维度信息得到拥堵指数, 拥堵指数聚类为5种拥堵类别以判断真实拥堵状态, 从而实现高速收费站的拥堵检测。实验结果表明, 在高速收费站拥堵数据集上, 采用多信息融合的拥堵检测算法准确率达到90.4%, 能够实现对收费站拥堵状态的准确检测。

items.title: 大语言模型智能体操作系统研究综述
items.title_zh: 大语言模型智能体操作系统研究综述
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型智能体操作系统,也叫智能体操作系统,是整合大模型、工具资源以及多智能体协同的核心平台,目前正逐渐成为推动通用人工智能发展的一个关键研究方向。对智能体操作系统领域的研究进展进行了系统梳理,首先从基础理论着手,回顾了多种大模型的演进情况以及智能体和传统操作系统领域的进展;接着,围绕典型体系结构,如AIOS等,阐述了其分层架构与模块化设计是怎样达成资源管理与智能调度的。进一步地,明确了当前智能体操作系统在上下文整合、扩展性以及安全性等方面面临的技术挑战,同时也提出了未来借助轻量化设计、自监督学习机制以及动态调度算法来提升多智能体协作效率。该研究的主要贡献为,将那些分散的研究给予整合,促使技术框架变得更为明晰,并指出了智能体操作系统对新兴体系以及行业定制化实践覆盖不全面的情况。未来的研究需要侧重推动跨域智能体操作系统自我进化的能力,并且加快其在各个领域的落地等。

items.title: 实际应用场景中的大模型高效推理技术综述
items.title_zh: 实际应用场景中的大模型高效推理技术综述
items.summary_zh: 近年来,大语言模型(Large Language Models,LLMs)技术迎来了快速发展,其在各行业的应用呈现出蓬勃增长的态势。从自然语言处理到智能推荐,再到信息检索和自动化写作,LLMs正逐渐成为许多领域中不可或缺的工具。然而,随着应用场景的逐渐多样化和需求的不断增加,LLMs推理效率问题日益凸显。在实际应用场景中,快速准确的推理能力对于响应用户请求、处理大规模数据和实时决策至关重要。为了应对这一挑战,学术界展开了广泛的研究和探索,致力于提高LLMs的推理效率。对此,全面调研了实际应用场景中有关LLMs高效推理的文献。首先,介绍了LLMs推理的原理,并分析了在实际应用场景中如何提高LLMs的推理效率。然后,引入了一个针对实际应用场景的分类系统,其主要分为3个层面,分别是算法优化层面、参数优化层面和系统优化层面;并对大模型进行相关研究的总结和归纳。最后,探讨了未来可能的研究方向。

items.title: Machine Learning-based Transcriptomic Data Analysis of Long COVID Patients: Generating Hypotheses for Molecular Signatures
items.title_zh: 基于机器学习的Long COVID患者转录组数据分析：生成分子特征假设
items.summary_zh: 引言：Long COVID（LC）仍是全球公共卫生挑战，估计影响10-30%的COVID-19幸存者。机器学习（ML）可帮助识别与LC相关的分子特征。人类离子通道（HIC）调节免疫细胞信号传导和细胞稳态，可能参与LC相关过程，并为相关通路和潜在药物再利用候选提供见解。方法：整合了来自六个数据集的COVID-19康复者和LC患者的RNA-seq数据，进行了预处理和批次效应校正。使用留一批次交叉验证评估监督ML模型，并用SHAP在验证折中识别特征。进行了功能富集、宿主-宿主和宿主-病毒蛋白-蛋白相互作用分析，随后对所得相互作用组中潜在HIC进行药物相互作用分析。结果：具有RBF核的支持向量分类器在六个验证折中达到平均AUC 0.664。对三个选定折（AUC = 0.722、0.836和0.817）的SHAP分析分别识别出225、153和241个基因。功能富集突出了包括组氨酸代谢和TNF信号传导

extra.description: Introduction: Long COVID (LC) remains a global public-health challenge, affecting an estimated 10-30% of COVID-19-survivors. Machine learning (ML) can help identify molecular features associated with LC. Human ion channels (HICs), that regulate immune-cell signaling and cellular homeostasis, may contribute to LC-associated processes and offer insights into relevant pathways and potential drug-repurposing candidates. Methodology: RNA-seq data from COVID-19-recovered and LC patients across six datasets were integrated, preprocessed, and corrected for batch effects. Supervised ML models were evaluated using leave-one-batch-out validation, with SHAP identifying features across validation folds. Functional enrichment, host-host and host-viral protein-protein interaction analyses were performed, followed by drug interaction analysis of potential HICs within the resulting interactome. Results: A support vector classifier with an RBF kernel achieved a mean-AUC of 0.664 across six validation folds. SHAP analysis of the three selected folds (AUC = 0.722, 0.836, and 0.817) identified 225, 153, and 241 genes, respectively. Functional enrichment highlighted pathways including histidine metabolism and TNF signaling. Among the 613 genes identified across these folds, 9 were HICs and 39 were immune signaling-related genes (ISGs), whose protein-protein interaction analysis revealed a pharmacologically relevant interactome. Furthermore, four HICs including CLCN3, KCNQ3, RYR1, and ZACN interacted with 30 approved drugs. Conclusion: ML-based analysis of integrated RNA-seq data identified HICs and ISGs associated with LC, while functional enrichment and PPI analyses provided insights into their potential biological relevance. Drug interaction analysis further highlighted candidate HIC-targeting drugs for future investigation in LC management. This computational framework provides preliminary, hypothesis-generating insights to guide future research.

items.title: NanoHIV-DR: a Nextflow workflow for consensus and read level HIV-1 drug resistance profiling from Oxford Nanopore sequencing
items.title_zh: NanoHIV-DR：一个用于从Oxford Nanopore测序进行共识和读段水平HIV-1耐药性分析的Nextflow工作流
items.summary_zh: Oxford Nanopore测序为HIV-1耐药性（HIVDR）基因分型提供了一种快速便携的方法，但分析所得长读段数据需要多个生物信息学步骤，目前可用的nanopore工作流有限。我们开发了NanoHIV-DR，一个基于Nextflow的工作流，可简化Oxford Nanopore测序数据的分析和HIVDR报告的生成。NanoHIV-DR处理原始POD5文件，经过碱基识别、解复用、宿主读段去除、质量过滤、读段比对和共识生成，然后识别耐药相关突变并解释预测的药物敏感性。该工作流提供两种互补的HIVDR分析方法：使用Sierra进行基于共识的耐药性解释，以及读段水平检测耐药相关变异，从而能够识别和量化低于共识水平的突变。输出与临床元数据整合，生成人类可读的HIVDR报告。NanoHIV-DR为基于Nanopore的HIVDR分析提供了一个可重复且可访问的工作流，减少了将长读段测序数据转化为可

extra.description: Oxford Nanopore sequencing offers a rapid and portable approach for HIV-1 drug resistance (HIVDR) genotyping, but analysis of the resulting long-read data requires multiple bioinformatics steps and currently available nanopore workflows are limited. We developed NanoHIV-DR, a Nextflow-based workflow that streamlines the analysis of Oxford Nanopore sequencing data and generation of HIVDR reports. NanoHIV-DR processes raw POD5 files through basecalling, demultiplexing, host-read removal, quality filtering, read alignment and consensus generation, before identifying resistance-associated mutations and interpreting predicted drug susceptibility. The workflow provides two complementary approaches to HIVDR analysis: consensus-based resistance interpretation using Sierra and read-level detection of resistance-associated variants, enabling mutations below the consensus level to be identified and quantified. Outputs are integrated with clinical metadata to generate human-readable HIVDR reports. NanoHIV-DR provides a reproducible and accessible workflow for Nanopore-based HIVDR analysis with reduced bioinformatics expertise and manual processing for translating long-read sequencing data into interpretable resistance profiles.

items.title: Machine learning prediction of antimicrobial resistance in respiratory metagenomes
items.title_zh: 机器学习预测呼吸道宏基因组中的抗菌素耐药性
items.summary_zh: 背景：对疑似呼吸道感染患者的靶向治疗传统上需要细菌培养，随后进行表型抗菌药物敏感性试验（AST），这一过程可能长达5天。在急性呼吸窘迫综合征（ARDS）中，延迟识别致病病原体及其耐药谱可能尤其有害，因为患者病情危重且常接受广谱经验性抗生素。抗菌素耐药性（AMR）负担日益加重，进一步复杂化了临床决策，减少了有效治疗选择并增加了初始治疗不足的风险。无培养、AI驱动的计算宏基因组策略有可能大幅缩短这一窗口，实现更快速的靶向治疗处方。为展示此类方法的可行性，我们开发了一个基于临床宏基因组学的概念验证框架。方法：我们使用具有相关抗菌药物敏感性表型的真实细菌基因组模拟了呼吸道宏基因组。每个模拟宏基因组包含固定的共生背景和一种临床重要呼吸道病原体——鲍曼不动杆菌、肺炎克雷伯菌或铜绿假单胞菌——细菌读段丰度为5%或10%。为Oxford Nanopore、PacBio和Illumina测序平台模拟了真实读

extra.description: Background: Targeted therapy for patients with suspected respiratory infections traditionally requires bacterial culture followed by phenotypic antimicrobial susceptibility testing (AST), a process that can take up to 5 days. In acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS), delays in identifying the causative pathogen and its resistance profile may be especially harmful because patients are critically ill and often receive broad-spectrum empiric antibiotics. The growing burden of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) further complicates clinical decision-making by reducing effective treatment options and increasing the risk of inadequate initial therapy. Culture-free, AI-driven computational metagenomic strategies have the potential to drastically shorten this window, enabling more rapid targeted therapy prescription. To show the feasibility of such approaches, we develop a proof-of-concept framework based on clinical metagenomics. Methods: We simulated respiratory metagenomes using real-world bacterial genomes with associated antimicrobial susceptibility phenotypes. Each simulated metagenome contained a fixed commensal background and one clinically important respiratory pathogen, Acinetobacter baumannii, Klebsiella pneumoniae, or Pseudomonas aeruginosa, at 5% or 10% bacterial read abundance. Realistic reads were simulated for Oxford Nanopore, PacBio, and Illumina sequencing platforms. Random Forest (RF) classifiers were trained and evaluated using five-fold, strain-grouped cross-validation with fold-specific {chi}2-ranked 13-mer features. ResFinder and KARGA were included as reference-based metagenomics benchmarks and evaluated using the same five held-out folds across the three sequencing platforms and two pathogen-abundance conditions. Results: RF performance varied substantially across species, antibiotics, and sequencing platforms. The strongest and most consistent results were observed for K. pneumoniae, with accuracy reaching approximately 0.96 for ceftazidime, 0.93 for amikacin, and 0.92 for ciprofloxacin. Performance for P. aeruginosa was more heterogeneous: long-read models performed well for amikacin, reaching 0.89 with PacBio and 0.88 with Nanopore, whereas Illumina performed substantially better for ciprofloxacin, ceftazidime, and levofloxacin, reaching accuracies of approximately 0.87, 0.77, and 0.70, respectively. Across most organism-antibiotic combinations, RF accuracy was numerically higher than the classification accuracies obtained with KARGA and ResFinder, which generally remained near 0.50. Increasing pathogen abundance from 5% to 10% and increasing the number of selected features from 2,500 to 5,000 generally produced modest improvements in classification accuracy, although the magnitude of improvement varied across organism-antibiotic combinations and sequencing platforms. Conclusions: Genome-wide k-mer machine learning can recover phenotype-associated antimicrobial resistance signals from simulated respiratory metagenomes, although performance depends strongly on the organism, antibiotic, and sequencing platform. These results represent a simulation-based proof of concept.

items.title: Predicted templates improve the prediction of antibody-antigen structures by AlphaFold 3 and Boltz-2
items.title_zh: 预测模板改善了AlphaFold 3和Boltz-2对抗体-抗原结构的预测
items.summary_zh: 动机：尽管蛋白质结构预测方法已有很大改进，但抗体-抗原复合物的成功率仍然很低。虽然可以通过计算量巨大的大规模采样来改善，但结果仍远不如大多数其他类型的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用。原则上，使用足够接近复合物天然结构的模板可以实现改进，但这些模板通常不适用于抗体-抗原复合物。结果：我们探索了使用由计算成本较低的刚体对接程序PIPER生成的模板。应用于无泄漏的抗体-抗原基准集，标准AlphaFold 3使用1000个随机种子时，56.2%的复合物将可接受或更好的模型作为顶级预测。在AlphaFold 3的非掩码版本中加入PIPER生成的模板，要么将成功率提高到63.4%，要么在约200次运行中达到相同的56.2%成功率。基于模板的方法同样改善了Boltz-2的抗体-抗原预测。这一结果表明，通过添加传统对接准备的模板可以扩展基于机器学习方法所探索的空间，弥补进化关系的缺乏和训练数据可用性的限制。可用性

extra.description: Motivation: In spite of the much improved protein structure prediction methods, the success rate remains low for antibody-antigen complexes. While this can be improved by computationally demanding massive sampling, results are still much poorer than for most other types of protein-protein interactions. In principle, improvement can be achieved by using templates that are close enough to the native structure of the complex, but these are generally not available for antibody-antigen complexes. Results: We explore the use of templates, generated by the computationally inexpensive rigid body docking program PIPER. Applied to a leakage-free antibody-antigen benchmark set, standard AlphaFold 3 with 1000 random seeds yields acceptable or better models as the top predictions for 56.2% of complexes. Adding the PIPER generated templates in the unmasked version of AlphaFold 3 either increases the success rate to 63.4%, or reaches the same 56.2% success rate in about 200 runs. The template-based approach similarly improves antibody-antigen prediction by Boltz-2. This result demonstrates that the space explored by the ML based approach can be expanded by adding templates prepared by traditional docking, compensating for the lack of evolutionary relationship and the limited availability of training data. Availability and Implementation: The ClusPro server (https://cluspro.bu.edu/login.php) containing the PIPER program is free for non-commercial applications and the program is available by request (https://www.vajdalab.org/). All other study data are included in the article and/or supporting information.

items.title: A Conserved Interface Between COG4 and Syntaxin 5 Is Essential for Intra-Golgi Membrane Trafficking
items.title_zh: COG4与Syntaxin 5之间一个保守界面对于高尔基体内膜运输至关重要
items.summary_zh: 保守寡聚高尔基（COG）复合物系连逆行高尔基体内运输囊泡，但其如何接合SNARE机制以支持囊泡融合仍不清楚。在此，我们鉴定了COG亚基COG4与Qa-SNARE Syntaxin 5（STX5）之间的功能性界面。COG4的C端区域与STX5共沉淀，AlphaFold3建模将COG4的MUN-C样亚结构域置于与STX5的Ha-Hb环及其连接Habc结构域与SNARE基序的连接子接触的位置。将Ha-Hb环替换为柔性Gly/Ser序列保留了STX5定位及其与SCFD1的相互作用，但损害了在STX5敲低细胞中对GPP130丰度和蛋白质糖基化的挽救。将环替换与连接子替换组合，降低了COG3和SNARE伙伴GS15与STX5的恢复，并导致囊泡在紊乱的高尔基体扁平囊周围积累。在COG4与Qa-SNARE界面的COG4一侧，保守残基D452和D453的丙氨酸替换降低了与STX5的共沉淀。将这些残基替换为丙

extra.description: The conserved oligomeric Golgi (COG) complex tethers retrograde intra-Golgi transport vesicles, but how it engages the SNARE machinery to support vesicle fusion remains unclear. Here, we identify a functional interface between the COG subunit COG4 and the Qa-SNARE Syntaxin 5 (STX5). The C-terminal region of COG4 coprecipitated with STX5, and AlphaFold3 modeling placed the COG4 MUN-C-like subdomain in contact with the STX5 Ha-Hb loop and the linker connecting its Habc domain to the SNARE motif. Replacing the Ha-Hb loop with a flexible Gly/Ser sequence preserved STX5 localization and its interaction with SCFD1 but impaired rescue of GPP130 abundance and protein glycosylation in STX5-depleted cells. Combining the loop replacement with linker substitutions reduced recovery of COG3 and the SNARE partner GS15 with STX5 and led to vesicle accumulation around disorganized Golgi cisternae. On the COG4 side of the interface with Qa-SNARE, alanine substitution of the conserved residues D452 and D453 reduced coprecipitation with STX5. Replacing these residues with either alanine or lysine preserved COG4 localization and COG8 recruitment to the Golgi but failed to restore normal glycosylation, GS15 localization, or altered Golgi morphology in COG4-knockout cells. These findings support a model in which the COG4-STX5 interface couples vesicle tethering to productive SNARE assembly, thereby controlling vesicular retrograde trafficking and Golgi organization.

items.title: Physical constraints on the social-genetic dynamics of mtDNA inside plant mitochondria
items.title_zh: 植物线粒体内mtDNA社会-遗传动力学的物理约束
items.summary_zh: 线粒体DNA（mtDNA）编码必需的细胞机器并包含在线粒体内。这种物理包含塑造了细胞中mtDNA群体的遗传动力学。在植物（及其他非两侧对称动物）中，mtDNA共定位对于重组至关重要，而其他细胞优先事项可能有利于mtDNA在细胞中的间隔分布。鉴于mtDNA与线粒体内膜及其嵴之间可能的物理相互作用，尚不清楚这种共定位可能多么容易或频繁地发生。目前仅有有限的间接证据支持植物mtDNA物理共定位的能力。在此，我们综述来自近期和新的单细胞延时显微成像的证据，以定量表征营养植物细胞中mtDNA拟核的运动。我们结合生物物理学论证与新的显微数据和空间统计学，证明拟核的亚扩散但非内部静止的性质，表明它们在 elongated 线粒体的末端富集，在细胞中间隔良好但能够共定位。我们还描述了可能影响mtDNA群体遗传动力学的其他物理运动模式，并讨论了这种物理行为对细胞质遗传学的意义。

extra.description: Mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) encodes essential cellular machinery and is contained within mitochondria. This physical containment shapes the genetic dynamics of mtDNA populations in the cell. In plants (and other non-bilaterians), mtDNA colocalisation is essential for recombination, while other cellular priorities may favour mtDNA spacing through the cell. Given possible physical interactions between mtDNA and the inner mitochondrial membrane and its cristae, it is not clear how readily or often this colocalisation may occur. Only limited, indirect evidence exists supporting the capacity for plant mtDNAs to physically colocalise. Here, we survey evidence from recent and new single-cell timelapse microscopy to quantitatively characterise the motion of mtDNA nucleoids inside vegetative plant cells. We combine biophysical arguments with new microscopy data and spatial statistics to demonstrate the subdiffusive but not internally static nature of nucleoids, demonstrating that they are enriched at the termini of elongated mitochondria and well-spaced through the cell but capable of colocalisation. We also describe other modes of physical motion that may impact the genetic dynamics of mtDNA populations, and discuss the implication of this physical behaviour for cytoplasmic genetics.

items.title: Non-invasive detection of tissue clonal mosaicism in chronic disease
items.title_zh: 慢性疾病中组织克隆嵌合的非侵入性检测
items.summary_zh: 液体活检改变了我们非侵入性 interrogate 体细胞基因组的能力，但其范围主要局限于产前检测中的胎儿遗传学和癌症中的肿瘤遗传学。克隆嵌合（CM）普遍存在于非恶性实体组织中，其中体细胞驱动突变在特定选择压力下扩增，并可能塑造慢性疾病的进程。对这一生物学的获取一直局限于侵入性组织活检，将该领域限制在小队列和单一时间点，并阻碍了大规模、临床关联的分析。在此，对慢性肝病患者的超灵敏无细胞DNA（cfDNA）测序揭示了来自匹配肝活检的全基因组体细胞变异，其血浆分数与癌症相当（10^-4 - 10^-5），信号对应于来自空间和系统发育相关克隆的变异。一个无需活检的靶向面板在81.5%的慢性肝病患者中检测到慢性肝病驱动基因的致病变异，在对照中不可检测，早期疾病中ACVR2A呈阶段特异性富集，移植后肝脏来源信号清除。将该框架扩展到炎症性肠病（IBD），我们在活动性溃疡性结肠炎中检测到IBD驱动基因的

extra.description: Liquid biopsy has transformed our ability to non-invasively interrogate the somatic genome, but its reach has been largely confined to fetal genetics in prenatal testing and tumor genetics in cancer. Clonal mosaicism (CM) pervades non-malignant solid tissues, where somatic driver mutations expand under specific selective pressures and may shape the course of chronic illness. Access to this biology has been limited to invasive tissue biopsies, restricting the field to small cohorts and single time points, and has precluded large-scale, clinically-linked analyses. Here, ultra-sensitive cell-free DNA (cfDNA) sequencing of patients with chronic liver disease revealed genome-wide somatic variants from matched liver biopsies at plasma fractions comparable to those of cancers (10^-4 - 10^-5), with signal corresponding to variants from spatially and phylogenetically related clones. A biopsy-naive targeted panel detected pathogenic variants in chronic liver disease driver genes in 81.5% patients with chronic liver disease, undetectable in controls, with stage-specific enrichment of ACVR2A in early disease and clearance of liver-derived signal following transplant. Extending the framework to inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), we detect clonal expansions of IBD driver genes in active ulcerative colitis, and observe greater detection in patients with pancolitis versus more localized disease. Together, these results open a new domain for cfDNA genetics beyond cancer and prenatal genetics, the non-invasive interrogation of somatic evolution in chronic disease, and establish a framework for the large-cohort, longitudinal, clinically linked studies of solid-tissue CM that has been inaccessible to the field.

items.title: Genomics of the diversification of Heliconius cydno (Lepidoptera: Nymphalidae) in northern South America: geographic and phenotypic patterns
items.title_zh: 南美洲北部Heliconius cydno（鳞翅目：蛱蝶科）多样化的基因组学：地理和表型模式
items.summary_zh: 自然选择、基因流和地理之间的相互作用是种群分化的关键驱动因素。本研究调查了它们对Heliconius cydno近期适应性辐射的影响，这是一种拟态和警戒色蝴蝶，在其分布于中美洲和南美洲北部期间，翅色图案具有显著变异。这种表型多样性的遗传基础具有模块化架构， whereby 少数关键基因和顺式调控元件控制形态型之间的差异。利用代表H. cydno所有亚种的133个个体的全基因组序列，我们研究了（1）安第斯造山运动在其多样化中的作用，以及（2）后翅白色亚缘带变异的遗传基础，迄今为止，这一点仍未知。首先，我们发现所描述的14个亚种中有5个对应于不同的单系谱系和明确的遗传簇，起源于南美洲西北部，后来扩展到中美洲和哥伦比亚安第斯山间谷地。其次，我们观察到与地理模式一致的遗传结构特征，特别是与安第斯山间地区和Gorgona岛相关的特征。第三，我们鉴定出ivory:mir-193是后翅白色亚缘带变异的潜

extra.description: The interplay between natural selection, gene flow, and geography is a key driver of population differentiation. This study investigates their influence on the recent adaptive radiation of Heliconius cydno, a mimetic and aposematic butterfly with striking variation in wing color pattern across its distribution in Central and northern South America. The genetic basis of this phenotypic diversity has a modular architecture, whereby a few key genes and cis-regulatory elements control differences among morphotypes. Using whole-genome sequences from 133 individuals representing all subspecies of H. cydno, we investigated (1) the role of Andean orogeny in its diversification and (2) the genetic basis of the variation in the hindwing white submarginal band, which to date, had remained unknown. First, we found that five of the fourteen described subspecies correspond to distinct monophyletic lineages and well-defined genetic clusters that originated in northwestern South America and later expanded into Central America and the Colombian inter-Andean valleys. Second, we observed signatures of genetic structure that were consistent with geographic patterns, particularly those associated with the inter-Andean region and Gorgona Island. Third, we identified ivory:mir-193 as the locus underlying variation in the white submarginal band on the hindwing. We also detected evidence of introgression suggesting that this trait was likely transferred from H. cydno to H. melpomene, contributing to the establishment of a novel mimicry ring with H. erato. Altogether, these findings highlight the roles of geography, genomic architecture, and introgression in the diversification of H. cydno.

items.title: The Impact of Germ Layer Origin on the Ageing Transcriptome
items.title_zh: 胚层起源对衰老转录组的影响
items.summary_zh: 衰老伴随着基因表达的广泛变化，但这些变化是否在组织组之间共享任何共同组织仍不清楚。成年组织起源于三个胚胎胚层（外胚层、中胚层和内胚层），因此共享的发育谱系可能影响组织的衰老方式。利用来自24个GTEx组织的批量RNA-seq数据，我们用limma-voom估计每个组织的年龄效应，并通过随机效应荟萃分析在每个胚层内合并它们。内胚层具有最显著的年龄相关基因（4,805个），其次是中胚层（4,520个）和外胚层（1,744个），但对于在同一胚层组织间具有一致效应的基因，这一顺序相反。这些一致基因在很大程度上是胚层特异性的，尽管中胚层和内胚层共享的比偶然预期的更多。同一胚层组织之间的衰老谱显著比不同胚层组织之间更相似。胚层起源也解释了组织衰老谱变异的13.6%。衰老的共表达网络在每个胚层中以不同方式组织，43%的富集生物学过程对某一胚层具有特异性。然而，在将相关过程分组后，大多数功能主题为所有三个

extra.description: Ageing is accompanied by widespread changes in gene expression, yet whether these changes share any common organisation across groups of tissues remains unclear. Adult tissues arise from three embryonic germ layers (ectoderm, mesoderm and endoderm), so shared developmental lineage could influence how tissues age. Using bulk RNA-seq data from 24 GTEx tissues, we estimated age effects in each tissue with limma-voom and combined them within each germ layer by random-effects meta-analysis. Endoderm had the most significant age-associated genes (4,805), followed by mesoderm (4,520) and ectoderm (1,744), but this order reversed for genes with consistent effects across tissues of the same germ layer. These consistent genes were largely germ layer specific, although mesoderm and endoderm shared more than expected by chance. Ageing profiles were significantly more similar between tissues from the same germ layer than between tissues from different germ layers. Germ layer origin also explained 13.6% of the variation in tissue ageing profiles. Co-expression networks of ageing were organised differently in each germ layer, and 43% of enriched biological processes were specific to one germ layer. However, after grouping related processes, most functional themes were shared by all three, and genes shared between modules of different germ layers were enriched mainly for immune processes. Together, these results indicate that germ layer origin leaves a small but detectable imprint on transcriptomic ageing. However, tissue-specific and shared immune programmes are also prominent.

items.title: Large populations from few founders: founder-aware likelihoods for inferring cell proliferation rates
items.title_zh: 来自少数创始者的大种群：用于推断细胞增殖率的创始者感知似然
items.summary_zh: 对人口噪声的高斯近似通常由大量细胞证明合理。然而，在由分支过程描述的种群中，源自少数创始者的大种群并非近似高斯。从少数细胞生长的培养物可能包含数千个细胞，但仍保留来自其最早分裂、死亡和表型转换的大幅偏斜变异。随机建立幅度，即种群大小除以其指数增长因子的极限，总结了这种变异。我们提出了一种用于终点观察的细胞培养的创始者感知似然。给定建立幅度，它通过高斯分布近似剩余的人口波动，然后对幅度的分布进行平均。其条件高斯近似需要大种群而非许多创始者，并且随着创始者数量增长，似然接近单一高斯分布。我们将其与为多创始者培养开发的种群高斯似然进行比较，使用纯出生（Yule）过程，其细胞计数分布已知精确，以及具有分裂、死亡和可逆转换的两类型过程的精确模拟。每个培养一个创始者时，创始者感知似然比种群高斯似然更准确地估计速率，其置信集更长但覆盖率接近名义水平。每个培养50个创始者时，两种似然表现相当。因此，创始者

extra.description: Gaussian approximations to demographic noise are usually justified by large numbers of cells. In populations described by branching processes, however, a large population descended from few founders is not approximately Gaussian. A culture grown from few cells can contain thousands of cells yet retain large, skewed variation from its earliest divisions, deaths, and phenotypic switches. A random establishment amplitude, the limit of the population size divided by its exponential growth factor, summarizes this variation. We propose a founder-aware likelihood for cell cultures observed at an endpoint. Given the establishment amplitude, it approximates the remaining demographic fluctuations by a Gaussian distribution and then averages over the distribution of the amplitude. Its conditional Gaussian approximation requires a large population rather than many founders, and the likelihood approaches a single Gaussian distribution as the founder count grows. We compare it with a population Gaussian likelihood developed for many-founder cultures, using a pure-birth (Yule) process, whose cell-count distribution is known exactly, and exact simulations of a two-type process with division, death, and reversible switching. With one founder per culture, the founder-aware likelihood estimates rates more accurately than the population Gaussian likelihood, and its confidence sets are longer but have coverage close to the nominal level. With 50 founders per culture, the two likelihoods perform comparably. Founder-aware likelihoods thus suit clonal and other few-founder experiments.

However, variation in tissue preparation and staining protocols remains a major source of technical variability, limiting reproducibility and comparability across studies and platforms. Here we present a large-scale, multisite and multi-platform benchmarking study of tissue preparation conditions for formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) tissues. We systematically evaluated 24 combinations of antigen retrieval and antibody staining conditions using a 27-marker immune panel and ranked performance using quantitative metrics that capture signal intensity, variability and marker failure. We further show that marker signal intensity correlated with greater spatial heterogeneity, improving the detection of diverse cell populations. Together, our results provide practical guidelines and a standardized benchmarking strategy to improve reproducibility, harmonize workflows and facilitate cross-study comparisons in spatial proteomics.

items.title: 图嵌入学习研究综述:从简单图到复杂图
items.title_zh: 图嵌入学习研究综述:从简单图到复杂图
items.summary_zh: 图数据作为一种具有强大表达能力的数据类型,因具有复杂的结构而难以高效建模。如何有效捕捉其中的内在信息,成为一个富有挑战性的问题。图嵌入方法将高维稀疏的图映射为低维稠密的特征向量,同时保留图的结构信息,已经引起了广泛关注。然而,现有综述对图嵌入方法的总结不够全面,尤其对复杂图嵌入的关注较少,导致处理多样化图数据的研究现状未能得到系统梳理。对此,从简单图到复杂图,对图嵌入学习方法进行了系统综述。首先,给出了各种类型的图和图嵌入的常见定义;其次,系统地归纳了简单图上的嵌入方法,包括浅层和深度图嵌入方法;然后,按照图的种类,总结了复杂图上的嵌入方法,重点介绍深度嵌入技术在动态图、异质图、多重图和超图等复杂图结构中的应用,以弥补现有文献对复杂图结构研究关注较少的不足;最后,讨论了图嵌入技术的实际应用场景,并展望了未来的发展方向。

items.title: 结合性别信息的多任务语音情感识别
items.title_zh: 结合性别信息的多任务语音情感识别
items.summary_zh: 现有的语音情感识别方法通常依赖深度学习模型提取声学特征,但大多仅关注通用特征的建模,未能充分挖掘数据中与情感密切相关的先验知识。为此,提出了一种端到端的多任务学习框架,利用自监督预训练模型WavLM提取包含丰富情感信息的语音特征,并将性别识别作为辅助任务,以捕捉性别差异对情感识别的潜在影响。针对传统多任务学习框架中固定权重计算损失导致的学习不均衡问题,进一步提出了一种自适应温度系数的动态权重平均方法(Temperature-aware Dynamic Weight Averaging,TA-DWA)。该方法通过动态调整温度系数平衡不同任务的学习速度,并结合任务损失变化率实现更合理的权重分配。实验结果表明,在IEMOCAP和EMODB数据集上,所提方法显著提高了情感识别准确率,验证了性别识别作为辅助任务的有效性以及动态权重策略在多任务学习中的优势。
